The mood conveyed in the text is eerie, melancholic, and ominous. The description of the "dark and unwelcoming" windows, the "howling" wind, and the personification of the house as "lamenting" its slumber creates an atmosphere of isolation and foreboding. This atmosphere contributes to the narrative by establishing a sense of mystery and tension, suggesting that the house holds secrets or a dark history that is about to be revealed or explored.
